sources.title: Aggregate layout identification
sources.evidenceNote: The operator Track One plan identifies both the southern straight and its parallel chicane while retaining the complete northern spiral. The catalogue general configuration contains both southern branches. The network groups these two independently mapped choices, excluding the separate AMC Fast inner shortcut absent from the published plan. Shared source edges count once and no diagram coordinates are copied. The independent unique branch distance is 3794 m; no coordinates are adjusted to a catalogue scalar distance. Identification only; no image coordinates copied.
